card.text: Explore Asterope in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Nonconvex ADAM reconstruction constrained by adaptive optics and occultation. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 1823 shape model
shape.summary: Nonconvex ADAM reconstruction constrained by adaptive optics and occultation; 107 km volume-equivalent diameter (±3 km). The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 1823 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 53.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
